description: Historical OHLCV price bars for a stock over a period, with optional computed technical indicators (SMA/EMA/RSI/ATR/Bollinger) and a tail projection (read-only, via the local Client Portal Gateway).

period.description: Lookback span in IBKR period syntax, e.g. 1d, 1w, 1m, 1y. Defaults to 1m. Alternative to from/to.

from.description: Explicit range start YYYY-MM-DD (alternative to period).

to.description: Explicit range end YYYY-MM-DD (alternative to period).

asOf.description: Point-in-time date YYYY-MM-DD (filters bars to t <= as-of).

indicator.description: Technical indicator columns computed over the bars, one metric per entry: sma<N>, ema<N>, rsi<N>, atr<N>, high<N>d, low<N>d, pct_change<N>d, bbupper<N>/bbmid<N>/bblower<N>, or bb<N> (all three bands; optional kM std-dev multiplier). E.g. ["sma20","sma50","sma200","rsi14"]. Fetch enough bars for the longest window (sma200 needs a ~1y daily period); early bars show null until the window fills.

tail.description: Emit only the last N bars (>= 1). Applied AFTER indicator computation over the full fetched series, so values are identical to the untailed run — combine with indicator and a long period to get just the latest values, e.g. tail 2.
